name: Open a small group discussion
short_description: Open a small group discussion once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can open a small group discussion in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Open a small group discussion means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Open a small group discussion in a fresh real-life scenario.

builds_on.note: Join an ongoing group conversation helps develop open a small group discussion but is not indispensable.

Repeat a spoken instruction accurately helps develop open a small group discussion but is not indispensable.
